title: Zeus’s answer; the night of feasting
intro: Zeus tells Poseidon he may destroy the wall later. The Greeks buy Lemnian wine and feast while Zeus thunders.

notes.text: σέο = σοῦ, gen of comparison; πολλόν, by far; ἀφαυρός, feeble: comparative.
χείρ, hand; μένος, might: accusatives of respect, “in hand and might.”
σός, your; κλέος, fame; the formula of 451 turned back on Poseidon.
ἄγρει = ἄγε, come now; μάν, indeed; ὅτ᾽ ἂν + subj, whenever.
οἴχομαι, be gone: 3pl pres subj (perfect sense); φίλην πατρίδα γαῖαν, dear fatherland.
ἀναρρήγνυμι, break up: aor ptc nom sg.
καταχέω, sweep down / pour over: aor inf, imperative sense; ἅλς, sea: acc ἅλα.
ἠϊών, beach: acc; ψάμαθος, sand: dat pl; καλύπτω, cover: aor inf.
ὡς + subj, so that; κεν; τοι = σοι, for you.
ἀμαλδύνω, destroy / efface: 3sg subj pass; the wall will be obliterated.
ἀγορεύω, speak: 3pl impf; πρὸς ἀλλήλους, to one another.
δύομαι, set: 3sg aor mid; τελέω, complete: 3sg plpf pass.
βουφονέω, slaughter oxen: 3pl impf, uncontracted; κατὰ κλισίας, in the huts.
δόρπον, supper; αἱρέομαι, take: 3pl 2aor mid.
Λῆμνος, Lemnos: gen sg; παρίστημι, come up: 3pl root aor (= παρέστησαν).
ἄγω, bring: pres ptc nom fem pl, of the ships.
προΐημι, send forth: 3sg aor; Ἰησονίδης, son of Jason: Euneus.
τίκτω, bear: 3sg 2aor; ὑπό + dat, “to” / by Jason; Ὑψιπύλη, Hypsipyle of Lemnos.
χωρίς, separately: a gift to the Atreidae apart from the sale.
ἄγω: pres inf, epic -έμεν, “to take”; μέθυ, wine; μέτρον, measure; χίλια, a thousand.
ἔνθεν, from there; οἰνίζομαι, supply oneself with wine: 3pl impf mid.
χαλκός, bronze; αἴθων, gleaming; σίδηρος, iron: dat of price.
ῥινός, hide: dat pl; αὐτῇσι βόεσσιν, with the live cattle themselves: epic dat pl.
ἀνδράποδον, slave: dat pl, epic -εσσι.
τίθεμαι, make for oneself: 3pl impf mid; δαίς, feast; θαλερός / θάλεια, plentiful.
παννύχιος, all night long: nom pl masc, adj used as adverb.
δαίνυμαι, feast: 3pl impf; ἐπίκουροι, allies.
σφιν, for them; μήδομαι, plan: 3sg impf; μητίετα, counselling: epithet of Zeus.
σμερδαλέος, terrible: neut pl as adverb; κτυπέω, crash / thunder: pres ptc, uncontracted.
χλωρός, pale: green-pale; δέος, fear; αἱρέω, seize: 3sg impf.
δέπας, cup: gen pl; χαμάδις, to the ground; χέω, pour: 3pl impf, uncontracted.
τλάω, dare: 3sg root aor; πρίν + inf, before; πίνω: aor inf πιέειν; λείβω, pour a libation: aor inf λεῖψαι.
ὑπερμενής, very mighty: dat sg; Κρονίων, son of Cronos.
κοιμάομαι, lie down to sleep: 3pl aor mid; ὕπνου δῶρον, the gift of sleep.
αἱρέομαι, take: 3pl 2aor mid; the book closes with the Greeks asleep.
